newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL says offer for Consumers is fair.
newsitem.headline: IPL says offer for Consumers is fair.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc said on Tuesday it believed that its C$24 a share cash offer or C$1.50 in cash and the equivalent number of IPL shares to total C$22.50 was a fair and reasonable price for the 15 percent of Consumers' Gas Co Ltd that it did not already own.

IPL said it had no intention of increasing the price or changing the terms of the offer since the C$24 a share price represented a substantial premium to the trading price of Consumers Gas absent an IPL offer.
Shareholder proxies must be received before the 1700 EST/2200 GMT November 26 deadline to be effective, IPL said.
